findings.title: Do not equate plain content to a rich-content cached value
findings.detail: nativeCellUnchanged returns true for desired {value:"hello"} and current {value:"hello",rich_text:[{type:"link",text:"hello",link:"https://example.test"}]}; multiple_values has the same issue. It guards cached formulas but ignores current structured content, so the import skips the replacement and retains the wrong content identity. Existing rich-source conversion test does not cover the inverse. Sheets owner independently reproduced both cases and is fixing.
